evidence_atoms.title: Cut build-pipeline cost by consolidating duplicate runners

star.situation: Three teams ran overlapping CI fleets with no shared capacity.
star.task: Reduce spend without slowing any team's build times.
star.action: Measured utilisation, consolidated the fleets onto shared autoscaling runners, and set per-team quotas.
star.result: Monthly CI spend fell by roughly a third; median build time was unchanged.

corroborators.reference: Director of Platform Engineering at the time
corroborators.notes: Approved the consolidation and saw the invoices.

star.situation: A six-person rotation was absorbing most of one engineer's week.
star.task: Reduce interrupt load without reducing coverage.
star.action: Triaged a quarter of alerts, deleted or merged the noisiest, and introduced a follow-the-sun handover.
star.result: Paging volume dropped substantially; the team reported the rotation as sustainable.

corroborators.reference: Two engineers who shared the rotation
corroborators.notes: Corroborated in conversation. No document captured, so this cannot be externally_verified yet.

evidence_atoms.title: Spoke on build reproducibility at a public conference

star.situation: The reproducibility work had no public write-up.
star.task: Present the approach to practitioners outside the company.
star.action: Submitted and delivered a conference talk on the toolchain and its limits.
star.result: Talk accepted and delivered; listed on the public programme.

corroborators.notes: Independent source recorded, so this atom earns externally_verified.

star.action: Claim recorded from the subject's own resume; no analysis obtained.
